column1: A ball vibrates on a spring and reaches resonance
A cube oscillates in water and produces resonance waves
A beam vibrates under the influence of wind and induces resonance
A point oscillates back and forth on a simple pendulum and experiences resonance
A disk rotates at a resonant frequency on a rotating platform
A string fixed at both ends is plucked and produces resonance
A sphere rolls back and forth in a cavity and reaches resonance
An air column in a tube resonates when blown
A ring slides on a rod and generates periodic motion due to resonance
Two oscillators with the same frequency couple with each other and produce resonance phenomena.
